test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following minerals has kieserite as its ore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnesium.**__

__
 
• **Kieserite **is the ore of **Magnesium.**
 
• Other ores are **Magnesite, Dolomite, Epsom Salt, and carnalite.**
